title: On Ramanujam's Theorem About Finite Dimensional Groups of Automorphisms
summary: Ramanujam's theorem states that any connected finite-dimensional subgroup of the automorphism group $\mathrm{Aut}(X)$ of an irreducible variety $X$ is an algebraic group, in a natural way. In this note, we discuss the notion of dimension and extend Ramanujam's theorem to arbitrary (not necessarily irreducible) varieties.
